Plot Reachable Walkable Network Length Map

Source: R/plot.R
walk_plot_reach.Rd

Generates a publication-grade cartographic visualization of reachable walkable network length using ggplot2. Segments are rendered in ascending order so dense, high-connectivity areas (yellow) plot on top. The color scale is clipped to the 2nd-98th percentiles with saturation arrows for optimal visual contrast.

Usage

walk_plot_reach(
  reach,
  boundary = NULL,
  palette = "viridis",
  p_clip = c(0.02, 0.98),
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  line_width = 0.4,
  dark = TRUE
)

Arguments

reach

A walk_reach object produced by walk_compute_reach().

boundary

Optional sf polygon representing the municipal or study boundary.

palette

Palette name for ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_c (default "viridis").

p_clip

Percentile range for color clipping (default c(0.02, 0.98)).

title

Optional custom title. Default highlights the isochrone budget.

subtitle

Optional subtitle.

line_width

Width of street lines. Default is 0.4.

dark

Logical. If TRUE (default), renders on a dark aesthetic canvas.

Value

A ggplot object.
